Hi Alex / Susan - following up on the quality questions. I attached a short benchmark CSV with the per-example deltas we measured across AWQ (q4_awq), GPTQ (q4_gptq), and a whitening FP8 run. High-level notes:

- Interactive short prompts (<= 128 tokens): AWQ gave the best throughput with negligible fidelity loss on ~85% of examples. Failure modes were mostly hallucinated numerical fields in ~5% of cases; those examples were long-context where numeric alignment mattered.
- Long contexts (>= 512 tokens): GPTQ preserved factual continuity better than AWQ in our runs, but had lower throughput on the same hardware.
- FP8: great throughput but visible stability issues on rare tokens; needs additional per-layer scaling and is the riskiest for production without thorough evals.

Recommended plan for Acme:
1) For interactive portal: start with q4_awq on Redwood-v2-13B-chat for latency (we measured ~220ms p50 on n1-standard A100 equivalent in our harness).
2) For nightly batch: use q4_gptq on the same model variant for stricter quality (cheaper at scale and easier QC).
3) Keep a small safe-path: a 7B FP8 candidate for extremely cost-constrained, but gate it behind a regression monitor and hard fallbacks to q8 or full-fp16 variant.

I've attached acme_benchmark_results.csv (per-example scores) and the quant_tradeoffs_awq_gptq_fp8.pdf that Marissa shared. We can run the 200-example eval within 48 hours once you share the S3 link.

-Neha
